avis.texte: This cleanser is super creamy and lightweight, and it smalls good! I was worried it wouldn't remove makeup well due to how lightweight it is, but I was pleasantly surprised.
smells so good and doesn't leave my skin feeling dry or stripped

I absolutely love this cleaner. It's mild but effective - I use an oil cleaner generally but I will say, this one removes all the makeup. I don't use waterproof makeup just fyi. It leaves the face feeling soft, moisturized and zero irritation.

avis.titre: Good alone or for double cleanse
avis.texte: Glad I added this to my daily routine - I alternate this as a double cleanse in the PM. I use on its own in the AM. Doesn't strip my skin leaves my skin soft and supple.
I just started tretinoin and I love how gentle and moisturizing this is.

I enjoy this cleanser but the scent is honestly not my favorite. I also definitely need to double cleanse with this because I don't think it's strong on its own. I will continue to purchase as I like it as part of my double cleanse routine!
So soft and gentle on my skin but very cleansing at the same time.

avis.titre: Love it and the bottle is HUGE!
avis.texte: I like to change up my cleanser, so I decided to try this on a whim. I need lots of moisture so was drawn to the milkiness of this one. Plus, I already have the OE scrub and love that. I was pleasantly surprised when this arrived that it's 5oz, not the usual 3oz that I'm used to in other brands. It's silky, smooth and cleanses without stripping. I'm a few weeks into using it and I love it. Will definitely buy again!
I love this product. It makes my sensitive skin feel smooth and vibrant. It is a great morning ritual.
This product feels great on my skin. It does not dry my skin out after using.

to start, the packaging is gorgeous and i loved the pump and glass bottle. the product smells of straight lemongrass, some might find pleasant but it took me by surprise. the application was very soothing and left my skin very soft after drying, as if it was working to retain the moisture. after a couple days of using though, i found myself beginning to show splotchy red patches across my face. this is my only change in my routine, so unfortunately i had to return. i thought the ingredients listed were very promising, so if you don't have highly reactive skin like mine you may really enjoy this cleanser.
What more can I say? It truly cleanse while nourishing the skin, leaving skin soft and hydrated. Just love it.
This cleanser is very nice. It feels great, has a great scent and does not irritate. It is in a glass bottle which is also amazing.
I love it!!! But I don't remember ordering it, but as I said I love it!! It's leaves my skin so soft, it's amazing🌟

This is my favorite face cleanser that I've ever used. It's the perfect balance of getting all of the grime off while somehow adding moisture. My face always feels so soft after using it and not like I have to rush to put moisturizer on it in order for it to be ok. Highly recommend.
I love this cleansing milk It feels so light and leaves a nice lite fragrance For the desert weather it's perfect Cleans your face without leaving a heaviness to it

The Nourishing CleansingMilk is exactly what I needed; something light but makes your face feel soft smooth and clean! I'm going thru medical treatments and was looking for a cleanser that didn't add to the dryness It works and now is my go to Cleanser!
This keeps your skin soft and moisturized while provide a complete clean feeling.

Very happy with this cleanser! Effective in removing make up & is truly softening! The slight fragrance is so fresh & interesting as in all the Oak Essentials products. Love the pump dispenser - perfect amount is released & saves over usage. Can't say enough about this line!

I am really enjoying this cleanser. It is so gentle. I was having tightness and burning sensation with my last cleanser. I now feel clean and soft after using the nourshing cleansing milk! No more burning!
Absolutely love the way it doesn't strip my face of all oil but gives a fresh clean feel and smell!!
Does a great job removing makeup but doesn't sting the eyes. So creamy with a lovely fresh scent!
Really like this. I thinkI might make this part of my routine :u1F973:
The only cleanser I'm using now. It's amazing and not too harsh on my skin.
This is very hydrating! It has been a great addition to my skincare routine.
Love it! It is light, not too greasy and has a nice mild scent.
Doesn't dry out skin and removes makeup making skin feel fresh and dewy.

avis.titre: The Love Your Skin Is Craving
avis.texte: Never thought I'd breakup with my old cleanser & quite frankly I had no intention or desire to sway from that decades long relationship. To that note, randomly found a sample of this when cleaning my bathroom, seconds later I'm ripping it open & washing my face. I got a whiff of this cleaning milk & a few hours later caught myself tryna buy it before I even knew how my skin was going to react to it. Ended up buying the full size cleansing milk maybe 72 hours later. Just got my second bottle at the beginning of this month. Proud to say Oak Essentials really is THAT GIRL … got me to fold on the cleanser I've been using for over half my life in a matter of 72 hours.

I love the smell and texture of this cleansing milk. It works great to remove all makeup and sunscreen without irritating my eyes or drying my skin. I used Farmacy Green Clean for years but this is my new favorite product!

First, I got a sample. Loved it enough to buy a bottle. Loved that so much I've bought a second bottle so I don't run out. This leaves the skin on my face so soft and so smooth with a wonderful flush of color. No really…my cheeks get a hit of pink after using this formula to was my face. I love it! And I'm just drawn to the scent.
Love this. I live in a dry climate and this has been wonderful to use. Smells fantastic as well.

avis.titre: glad I bought the full size
avis.texte: I had used several samples and decided to buy the full size. I love it, it takes off my make-up without drying my skin and it smells lovely.
I really like this cleanser. It feels super luxurious and doesn't dry out my skin.
The cleansing milk is part of my daily routine and it is the best.

I actually feel excited to take my makeup off at night because of how much I love this cleanser. The smell is DIVINE. It feels moisturizing and cleansing all in one. I've been using this, the balancing toning mist and the ritual oil and my skin looks better than it has ever looked. I'm excited to try more from this brand!

"I've tried every expensive cleanser out there, and the Oak Essentials Cleansing Milk honestly beats them. It feels like a hydrating hug for my skin, melts everything off, and never strips. For the price, it's such a win — my skin is so thankful. "
Gentle and nourishing, leaving my skin feeling clean. Great for double cleaning. This will be a staple in my future skincare routine.
If I'm not in the mood for the more-exfoliating cleanser, this is my favorite option. It's so mild - effective enough to get my makeup off but doesn't leave my skin stripped of oils or moisture.
The scent, the moisture, and the cleanse - this is perfection!

I recently relocated to a new city and the change in water made a noticeable negative impact on my skin. Within one use of this cleanser, my skin was already feeling less tight, not stripped of all moisture. It glides on and has a very light lather, and of course has the gorgeous scent profile that Oak Essentials products share. My husband has even started using it and loves it!
So fresh, clean, non oily but hydrating for my combo skin/eczema, smells luxurious
Love this fresh face wash, leaves my face feeling clean!:u1F9FC:
Love this face wash but the bottle spout must have been defective because it broke off causing the bottle to fall and shatter on the floor
This product is excellent at getting my makeup off at the end of the day. It helps me get everything off without stripping my skin, leaving my skin hydrated and clean.
A lovely cleanser; not too thick but not at all drying. Leaves skin clean but nourished.
Love this cleanser - it is so refreshing and leaves my skin super soft. I use it nightly!

Wow! The Oak Essential Cleansing Milk feels so luxurious on my face. . . . . like silk! A hint of a scent yet a very clean and smooth feeling. I love using it!!!! Puts all the other cleansers I was using to shame.

avis.titre: The perfect partner with the Renew Face Polish
avis.texte: I alternate using this and the Polish with using this in the morning and the polish in the evening. It's a refreshing cleanser that makes my skin feel soft and supple.
This is a good cleanser, I've noticed it's creamy and makes my skin feel soft. So far so good!

This product is perfect as a part of my nighttime routine. Its. restorative qualities replenish what occurred throughout my day while still being able to complete the nightly routine, making it an excellent base.
The nourishing cleansing milk makes my skin feel so soft. I will be purchasing it on a regular basis. A friend of mine was visiting she tried it and loved it as well. She will be ordering it as well.

avis.titre: My new favorite cleanser! But wish it came in a travel size.
avis.texte: I just started using this cleanser a few weeks ago, and I've really noticed a difference in my skin. We have hard water in north county San Diego, and this cleanser says it helps counteract the effects of hard water, which I love and think is really unique for a cleanser. However, I'm about to go on a two week vacation to Europe, and I'm really bummed to see this does not come in a travel size. Please make this!!!
This is my favorite of the oak essentials cleansers. It's gentle, removes eye makeup well, nourishing, and smells divine.

avis.titre: Seen amazing results after the first use!!
avis.texte: I've just started my regimen and this product is great. I could tell a difference within my first day.
This face wash mixed right into my daily routine and I love the results

avis.titre: Nourshing Cleansing Milk is the BEST!!!
avis.texte: The Nourshing Cleansing Milk is so light and removes my eye makeup fabulously! No residue. I love the low fragrance factor. Nothing worse then cleansing your face and have strong fragrance overwhelming your nasal passage!
I can't survive without this. It's so gentle and makes my skin so soft and smooth.
Light texture and wonderful fragrance. It's a pleasure to use.
This cleanser doesn't disappoint. It has a soothing scent, is smoothing on the skin and one pump makes my skin feel refreshed and hydrated.

I absolutely love this face wash. I've been using oak essentials for years, but there's something about the consistency and the lightness of this product that makes it my new favorite. It is smooth and soft and still cleans the skin very well.
This cleansing product is a great product for my face. The scent smells like a luxurious spa.
This feels like a spa experience but is also so effective. It removes mascara thoroughly, no traces left. But it doesn't strip my skin of moisture. It smells and feels great.
This does a great job in gently cleansing my skin. I definitely have to use two pumps to be able to get all of my makeup off. Leaves my skin feeling great!
Truly obsessed with the smell/feel of this. Highly recommend washing for 60secs and your skin will glow!!!
I have combination skin that is sensitive to really anything… Most cleansers strip my skin to dry but this one is absolutely amazing! Not harsh at all, plus it has improved my acne tremendously! :)

Everything about this product is amazing. The smell gives you a feeling of peace and makes my skin feel clean and renewed. I highly recommend this addition to your skin care routine. I followed with the nighttime serum and oil to provide a serene nights sleep.

It is my hope that this feedback is shared with Oak Essentials. This cleanser is wonderful, creamy and lightweight. Does not dry out my skin and smells like a day at the spa. I am 61 years young with combo skin. The reason I took one star off is the heavy glass bottle. Please re-think your packaging to something not so heavy. Also, the lid slides off easily and that is another issue. Need to carefully hold it or the bottle will end up on the ground. Happened to me twice.

Great cleanser. I used to have to use two- one to take make up off second to wash. Now I have this one step cleanser and it does the job of both. And it smells like a spa visit, like all OE products. Get it!

ABSOLUTELY AMAZING!!!! I never used a milky cleanser before, and this is the only one I'll ever use. It's pricey but it lasts a long time and is extremely high quality. 2 pumps is all you need! And oh my gosh, it smells so so good. I can't get enough of it! This brand in general, is THE BEST!!!
This is the cleanser I use every morning and it really helps wake up my skin without drying it out.

Im an esthetician so im pretty picky when it comes to products. Im almoat finished with my first bottle and its teally made a difference with my skin. Im acne prone and very senstive and this one has made my skin so happy and glowy and has not made me more oily like most creamy cleansers. I hope they eventually sell a refill pouch or a smalelr travel size option
I love this product. It cleans my face well and leaves it feeling fresh. No dryness afterwards. It will definitely be one of my stables along with the balancing mist.
This cleanser is perfect for my dry skin! I'm obsessed with the light scent! Does not leave my skin feeling tight or irritated. Has a lovely texture as well.
A lovely, fresh feeling face wash that leaves your skin feeling hydrated and clean. Removes make up really well too!
This cleanser is gentle, however it gets the job done. My daughter loved it so much, she took mine and I had to buy her another one, on subscription!
Oh I love this! I put it on after the vitamin c in the mornings and after the retinol at night. Very happy with how it makes my skin feel!
So good and smoothing. Isn't stripping but does the job. Great so sensitive dry skin!

The Nourishing Cleansing Milk is incredible! It effortlessly removes all my makeup and dirt, leaving my skin feeling fresh and clean without any dryness. It's so gentle yet effective, and it feels so soothing on my face. I love how it cleanses deeply while still being super nourishing—perfect for my daily skincare routine!
Love the gentle herbal fragrance and fresh cleansing power of this Oak Essentials Cleansing Milk.
I love this face cleanser as a gentle 2nd wash after removing makeup at the end of the day, leaves my skin feeling so smooth and moisturized - plus the lemongrass scent is so relaxing
So I was advised to try the milky face wash, & I am so loving the smell and softness it leaves my skin. Its a wow for me, cant stop touching my cheeks :)

This cleansing milk works and a little goes a long way. It swipes away make up even with a gentle cleanse. The scent is lovely, although a little more floral than most of the other Oak Essential products. Unlike many cleaners, my skin feels moisturized after washing with the cleansing milk.
I am obsessed with the feel and smell of this! It is gentle and makes my skin feel clean while not drying it out. It also smells like a heavenly spa.
In love. New favorite. Smells just like a day spa and leaves skin so soft.
Love this cleanser! The smell is divine and it makes my face feel so fresh!

I enjoy this cleanser. It has a natural scent, it cleans well, and it nourishes well. It is a good consistency too — not too watery, not too thick. It's made me what to try other Oak Essentials products!
I love this face cleaner. It smells absolutely amazing. My skin feels so soft after I use it. No matter my not so good water at the house.
love this nourishing cleansing milk! It has a fabulous creamy luxurious texture and leaves my skin feeling so soft and moisturized. I follow the cleaning with the moisturizing routine!!
